findings.evidence: Opening spoken question plus visible search/pruning provides an initial hook and small payoff. The viewer benefit and next question are less specific than they could be.
The full formal patent title and process vocabulary occupy the next chapter before the driving situation is developed.
3→9→27, the cyclist remaining represented, and pruning versus hardware parity are useful learning rewards. They have no explicit question/payoff contract.
The complete left-turn setup begins around01:29 after the opening teaser. Start the main explanation inside this situation.
No retention contract, promise/payoff mapping, value-gap checks or editorial retention gate exists in the delivered v1 source. Original supplied-plan hook notes are prose, not enforced behavior.

171.4s (55.4% of runtime) uses graph/growth/layers/pruning/scores/evidence modes with recurring studio backgrounds. Street/follow/wheel views improved variety, but the abstract explaining areas remain sparse. This is a mode classification, not a measured attention score.
Score-bar heights use a sine animation without being driven by the narrated physical consequence. Movement by itself does not deliver a knowledge payoff.

Preferred narrator and measured pace are present. The producer schedules quiet movement cues; it has no semantic prompt/pause/reveal schedule. Camera beats are largely duration quarters rather than measured spoken-thought events. This finding concerns code and script, not an auditory listening judgment.
Pruning is teased/explained briefly in the opening; the dedicated threshold-and-removal chapter starts around03:32. Bring a concrete useful demonstration forward and build later depth around it.
No YouTube retention curve, watch-time data, audience drop-off or A/B result is available. No retention percentage or guaranteed engagement can be verified.

rungs.new_knowledge: Waiting is a candidate decision linked to the actual crossing and oncoming traffic.
Three alternatives at each of three stages produce27 sequences in this example.
A trajectory links dependent interactions to a goal rather than being an isolated line.
Changing relevance to a candidate interaction does not justify ignoring the road user.
Candidate evaluation can consider several behavior factors rather than an invented single score.
Threshold pruning stops developing a poor candidate and directs expansion toward promising nodes.
An application about planning does not establish deployment or feature parity for a specific hardware generation.
The viewer can distinguish pruning candidate decisions from losing representation of an agent.
